folds: Existing native StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42), checked against saved fold indices
solver: reuse verified streaming damped Newton, max gradient 1e-8
test_drift: Compute each arm from the mean of its five fitted meta coefficient vectors (mean logits), compare extended arms to matched baseline on OOF/test; no full-data meta refit or new submission in this screen.
limitations: Fixed public-base OOF meta-CV; not end-to-end nested CV.
Upstream early stopping, mixed source folds, indirect label dependence and historical selection persist.
Paired fold SE is descriptive and does not cover selection bias or upstream dependence.
Kumo alignment relies on audited original row order; resumed source cache history not independently reconstructed.
The two weak candidates are screened for conditional contribution, not presumed useful.
